a: Meaningful alt text describes image purpose for screen readers.
All interactive controls should be reachable by keyboard.
Visible focus indicators help keyboard users know where they are.
Do not convey information by color alone.
Inputs need associated labels for accessibility.
Empty states should explain what to do next.
Show progress so users know the app is working.
Errors should say what happened and how to fix it.
Serve appropriately sized images for different screens.
A design system standardizes components and patterns.
